verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an MCP control-plane platform, but the evidence pack documents no bulk or batch capability. What it does document is single-resource admin actions through the platform MCP and CLI, role-based provisioning, and a customer story about onboarding 200+ servers. None of these describes performing one operation across many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
